content.title: Why Charles Barkley Looks Different: Weight Loss, Health Journey and March Madness Buzz | Sportsnet Pittsburgh
content.text: Charles Barkley is an NBA legend, but every March he becomes something else for college basketball fans: one of the defining personalities of the NCAA Tournament. Between the jokes, the bracket chaos and the unfiltered reactions on set, Barkley has become a huge part of the March Madness experience. This year, though, plenty of viewers have noticed something else — Barkley looks slimmer than he did just a few years ago.How did Charles Barkley lose weight?Barkley has been open about his weight-loss journey. In 2023, he said he had dropped 62 pounds after starting at 352 pounds, crediting a weekly shot of Mounjaro along with exercise. He said the medication helped him control his appetite and improve habits that had been tough to manage for years.He has also explained the motivation behind the change in very Barkley fashion. Barkley said a blunt warning from his doctor pushed him to take his health more seriously, and he has repeatedly framed the goal as living longer and feeling better.Where Barkley’s health journey stands nowBarkley’s progress has not been perfectly linear. In 2025, Ro announced a partnership with Barkley and said he had previously lost nearly 50 pounds on a GLP-1 medication before running into supply and access issues, stopping treatment and regaining much of the weight. Barkley said that was part of why he restarted his journey with Ro.That matters because it gives fans a more realistic picture of weight loss. Barkley’s story has not been a simple before-and-after transformation. It has included progress, setbacks and a restart — which is a big reason it has connected with so many people.What is Mounjaro and how do GLP-1 drugs work?Mounjaro is the brand name for tirzepatide, a medication that mimics GLP-1 and GIP hormones involved in appetite and blood sugar regulation. According to Harvard Health, drugs in this family help people feel fuller, slow digestion and reduce hunger signals, which can make weight loss easier when paired with diet and exercise.For Barkley, the result has been one of the most visible health transformations in sports media. He is still the same loud, funny and unpredictable presence college basketball fans expect every March — just with a very different look than the one viewers got used to over the years.
